text: {"bodies": ["Have you heard people whispering around the labs about Sofia Korhonen (e12) lately? I have zero way of knowing if there is anything to it, just idle chatter, really, though some folks are wondering if she might be connected to those leaked documents. Probably total nonsense, even if it makes you wonder.", "Honestly, if anyone is slipping confidential files out the door, my money is completely on Olli Jarvinen (e28). He always acts like basic rules are beneath him and can't even be bothered to clear his dirty coffee mugs out of the shared conference room. It would be so typical of someone that insufferable to be behind the leaks."]}
